yt_title: The Death Everyone Fears Is 88x Rarer Than a Bee Sting
yt_description:
What are your real lifetime odds of dying from different causes? Heart disease is 1 in 6 and a car crash 1 in 101, while a shark attack is just 1 in 3.7 million, about 88 times rarer than dying from a bee or wasp sting (1 in 42,626).

Which one scares you most? Comment it below, the real odds might change your mind.
